# Grandfathered naming findings — passable, but only these.
#
# What this is
# ------------
# validate-csharp-xaml-naming.ps1 reads this file and does NOT report a finding listed here. Everything
# listed was already failing when this list was made; nothing here was introduced by a change that this
# list was written to hide.
#
# Created: 2026-10-11
#
# Why these are passable
# ---------------------
# These 249 findings pre-date feature 012 (specs/012-waitlist-card-layout) and were the guard's entire
# failure set before that work started. The owner's instruction (2026-10-11) was to grandfather the
# pre-existing findings and FIX the ones belonging to that feature, rather than spend a release renaming
# working identifiers the feature never touched. The feature's own 16 findings were fixed in code and are
# deliberately NOT listed here: if one of them reappears it must fail the guard.
#
# Format
# ------
# One finding per line:
#
#     <relative\path>|<message>
#
# Path as the guard prints it (leading .\ dropped, backslashes), then the message text that follows the
# line number. NO line number is recorded on purpose: line numbers shift with every edit above them, so a
# line-keyed list would silently stop matching and grant a pass to whatever moved into that line.
#
# Rules for changing it
# ---------------------
# 1. Never add a line to make a new finding pass. Fix the code, or state the reason in the commit.
# 2. Deleting a line is always allowed and always welcome: it means somebody fixed that one.
# 3. A count that changes without a matching code change means the guard's rules changed; re-derive the
#    list rather than editing it by hand.
#
